description: What one trader on the FOMO app did in the last 7 days, by FOMO name: buys with the market cap at the buy, sells with the realized profit the feed reported, the tokens touched, a record once 15 buys have been scored, and the Robinhood Chain wallet when PumpPill has matched one. Large trades only, no sizes; found=false means not seen in our data (it starts 2026-09-30), not that the trader is inactive.
name: fomo_trader
title: One FOMO trader's recent trades
